title: Banana Imagery Dataset - Tanzania
description: The banana images dataset was created to contribute to the study of banana diseases diagnostics. The images target the diagnostics of Black Sigatoka and Fusarium Wilt Race 1 diseases. We are motivated in developing end to end tools to help farmers diagnose diseases and improve banana productivity. The dataset was created to facilitate image classification and object detection tasks.
